fields.description: Title magic 'WIZARDRY(Ver121)' at save start; extends the verified stub WIZA prefix byte-for-byte.
fields.evidence: Baseline bytes 0x00-0x0F equal 'WIZARDRY(Ver121)' (stub magic [87,73,90,65] is its 4-byte prefix). Decomp string table is stripped (only DAT_0000001d-style refs survive, e.g. in FUN_0800d35e), so grounding is byte-level via samples/baseline.sav plus stub.
fields.name: title_magic

fields.description: Header roster slot 0: monster ID 227; same ID space (199-275) as summon move-list tails.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800d35e walks a record table (+0x138/entry) with ushort member loads/stores ((unaff_r7+0x39)); save-side u16 at file 0x14 reads 227, matching tail-list ID range; FFFF sentinels at file 0x10 and 0x1E frame the 5-entry roster.
fields.name: roster_id_0

fields.evidence: FUN_0800d35e record-table walker with ushort member access; save-side u16 at file 0x16 reads 275, inside the 199-275 tail-list ID space; framed by FFFF sentinels at file 0x10/0x1E.
fields.name: roster_id_1

fields.evidence: FUN_0800d35e record-table walker with ushort member access; save-side u16 at file 0x18 reads 201, inside the 199-275 tail-list ID space; framed by FFFF sentinels at file 0x10/0x1E.
fields.name: roster_id_2

fields.evidence: FUN_0800d35e record-table walker with ushort member access; save-side u16 at file 0x1A reads 215, inside the 199-275 tail-list ID space; framed by FFFF sentinels at file 0x10/0x1E.
fields.name: roster_id_3

fields.description: Header roster slot 4: monster ID 199; also appears as summon0 move 1, linking roster to entries.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800d35e record-table walker with ushort member access; save-side u16 at file 0x1C reads 199, equal to the u16 at file 0xFA (summon0 move 1); framed by FFFF sentinels at file 0x10/0x1E.
fields.name: roster_id_4

fields.description: Summon entry 0 base ranks: six rank bytes, constant across entries 0-5.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a2f8 indexes a record table (param_1 * 0x3FC stride) with small member loads (+0x26); save-side entries start at file 0x2C with stride 0xE4 and share the 6-byte prefix 08 08 05 08 08 09 across entries 0-5 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: summon0_base_ranks

fields.description: Summon entry 0 HP: constant 100 across entries 0-5.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800d35e record walker does ushort member access at +0x39 (adjacent to +0x38); save-side u16 at file 0x38 (entry0 +0x0C) reads 100 in each of entries 0-5 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: summon0_hp

fields.description: Summon entry 0 stat-cap table: eight 0x0FFF caps.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a2f8 record-table accessor (param_1 * 0x3FC, +0x26 member load); save-side bytes at file 0x44-0x53 (entry0 +0x18) are eight u16 0x0FFF in each of entries 0-5 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: summon0_stat_caps

fields.description: Summon entry 0 owned/active marker: 1 in entries 0-5, 0 in empty slots.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008098 stores whole-word members at +0x30 in a record struct; save-side u32 at file 0x58 (entry0 +0x2C) reads 1 for entries 0-5 and 0 for empty entry slots in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: summon0_active_flag

fields.description: Summon entry 0 slot index: 0-5 across entries 0-5, low byte of the +0x30 member.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008098 accesses record-struct members at +0x30/+0x32; save-side byte at file 0x5D (entry +0x31) increments 0,1,2,3,4,5 across entries 0-5 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: summon0_entry_index

fields.description: Summon entry 0 level: 10 in every populated entry 0-5; primary live-mutation scalar.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008098 reads/writes a record-struct member at +0x32 ((int)piVar13 + 0x32); save-side u16 at file 0x5E (entry0 +0x32) reads 10 in each of entries 0-5 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: summon0_level

fields.evidence: FUN_08008098 writes one-byte record members (e.g. (char *)(extraout_r1_00 + 0x10)); save-side bytes at file 0x68-0x6F (entry0 +0x3C) read 01 01 01 00 00 01 01 00 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: summon0_ability_flags
